title: Short exact complex presentation on an arbitrary open union
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose derived category of module sheaves and the derived categories on all localized open sites exist in a common Hom universe [def-pc-derived-category]. For every open $T$, write $R_T=D(\operatorname{overFunctor}_T)$, and fix a functor $G_T$ and an adjunction $a_T:R_T\dashv G_T$. Let $U,V$ be arbitrary opens and $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$. Set $A=G_{U\cup V}R_{U\cup V}(E)$, $B=G_UR_U(E)\oplus G_VR_V(E)$, and $C=G_{U\cap V}R_{U\cap V}(E)$. Let $\beta:R_{U\cup V}A\to R_{U\cup V}E$ be the transpose of $1_A$, and let $b:A\to B$ be the biproduct lift of the $a_U$ and $a_V$ transposes of the two canonical restrictions of $\beta$ [lem-sc-derived-hom-mayer-vietoris]. There is a short complex $S$ of cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and isomorphisms $e_A:Q(S.X_1)\xrightarrow\sim A$, $e_B:Q(S.X_2)\xrightarrow\sim B$, $e_C:Q(S.X_3)\xrightarrow\sim C$, such that $S$ is short exact and $Q(S.f)\,;\,e_B=e_A\,;\,b$, where the semicolon denotes composition in order of application. No connecting map, integer shift or distinguishedness is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08BV, lemma-exact-sequence-j-star, displayed short exact sequence of complexes in the proof, applied on U union V and viewed by ordinary direct image on X; Tag 079W, lemma-adjoint

proof.text: For the derived object E, choose a K-injective representative I with injective terms [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. For T equal to U union V, U, V, or U intersect V, let J_T be the complex obtained by restricting I to T and taking ordinary direct image, degree by degree. Use [lem-pc-open-derived-localization-adjunction] to place open-scheme categories in the given Hom universe, and [lem-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-comparisons] to identify these complexes with derived direct images. Compare the open-scheme restriction with localized-site restriction by the exact derived composition and localization isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Uniqueness of right adjoints transports these comparisons to the specified G and adj. No distinguished triangle is used.

Construct S with objects J_(U union V), J_U direct-sum J_V, and J_(U intersect V), and arrows the pair of restrictions and their difference. Functoriality of restriction gives their zero composite. For each open Z and degree n, sheaf gluing gives injectivity and middle exactness of the section sequence on Z intersect (U union V), Z intersect U, Z intersect V, Z intersect U intersect V. The last restriction-difference is surjective by [lem-sc-ringed-space-injective-restriction-surjective] for I^n. Thus the section sequence is short exact, so the sequence of sheaves, and then the complex S, is short exact. Empty opens give zero terms; repeated opens give the split diagonal/difference sequence.

Normalize the computation isomorphisms at the four opens by the unique natural isomorphism of right adjoints compatible with their adjunctions. The supplied union counit is the transpose of identity. Restricting it to U or V uses the canonical nested-restriction comparison [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Compatibility of the computation with nested restriction [lem-pc-open-image-complex-comparison-restriction], and naturality of the right-adjoint comparison, identify the transpose with the corresponding component of the first map of S. The biproduct comparison combines the two identities into Q(S.f) followed by eB equals eA followed by b. There is no assertion about the second arrow after localization or any connecting map.

proof_origin.note: Short-exact-complex part of the proof of Tag 08BV, read on the Stacks tag page. The adaptation to arbitrary unions and localized right adjoints is expanded using the existing computation and nested-restriction nodes.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits for MayerVietorisSquare, its additive-group sheaf shortComplex, shortComplex_exact, shortComplex_shortExact and Opens.mayerVietorisSquare. None supplies the K-injective module-complex presentation with specified derived right adjoints.

DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES_distinguished in Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.DerivedCategory.ShortExact. It constructs a triangle from an already supplied short exact complex; it does not provide the geometric presentation.

Eleven hits for generic triangle and shift tools in Mathlib; none constructs the geometric short exact sequence. Additional project search found schemeKInjective_mayerVietoris_presentation, which assumes a whole-space cover and uses open-scheme categories.

lean.statement: theorem derived_open_union_ses_presentation (X : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [∀ W : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over W))] (U V : X.Opens) (G : ∀ W : X.Opens, DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over W)) ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory X) (adj : ∀ W : X.Opens, (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) W).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ G W) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) : let R := fun W : X.Opens ↦ (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) W).mapDerivedCategory let A := (G (U ⊔ V)).obj ((R (U ⊔ V)).obj E) let B := (G U).obj ((R U).obj E) ⊞ (G V).obj ((R V).obj E) let C := (G (U ⊓ V)).obj ((R (U ⊓ V)).obj E) let β := ((adj (U ⊔ V)).homEquiv A ((R (U ⊔ V)).obj E)).symm (𝟙 A) let b := biprod.lift ((adj U).homEquiv A ((R U).obj E) (derivedOpenHomRestriction X.toRingedSpace (homOfLE le_sup_left) β)) ((adj V).homEquiv A ((R V).obj E) (derivedOpenHomRestriction X.toRingedSpace (homOfLE le_sup_right) β)) ∃ (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)) (eA : DerivedCategory.Q.obj S.X₁ ≅ A) (eB : DerivedCategory.Q.obj S.X₂ ≅ B) (eC : DerivedCategory.Q.obj S.X₃ ≅ C), S.ShortExact ∧ DerivedCategory.Q.map S.f ≫ eB.hom = eA.hom ≫ b
